dedupe_keys.name: lietuvos elektros energijos vartotoju suvartojimo duomenys pagal regionus

description: Lietuvos elektros energijos vartotojų suvartojimo duomenys pagal regionus is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AB „Energijos skirstymo operatorius“. This data set presents the consumption data of all Lithuanian electricity consumers. The information is updated semi-annually. Data is provided in CSV format. Data for each half-year are presented in three files, broken down by region, consumption in kWh. Coverage: AB „Energijos skirstymo operatorius“. The portal shows the English title as "Data on Lithuanian electricity consumption by regions" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AB „Energijos skirstymo operatorius“. Its keywords include Kwh, Suvartojimas. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
